question:
The given bar graph shows the profit (in ₹ lakhs) made by a company from 2001-2002 to 2008-2009.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac3ba03ad5fb0bfab1a03b9d891eafb3e07e5c0f7f7d4d3b90dfb144aabd79d6.png] 

The profit in 2005-06 was approximately what percentage of the average profit over the entire period?
solution:
**Given:**

Profits (in ₹ lakhs) from 2001-02 to 2008-09:

650, 730, 520, 680, 740, 490, 660, 810

Profit in 2005-06 = 740

**Formula used:**

Average Profit = frac{{Sum of all profits}}{{Number of years}}</
